claimed_purpose.text: Memory consolidation engine that synthesizes related observations from coding sessions into single long-term memories
agentmemory captures observations from agent activity and compresses them via LLM into a persistent memory store
Explicitly saves curated insights, decisions, and patterns to long-term memory (distinct from raw session log)
Persistent memory for AI coding agents, local-first with no external databases required.

mechanisms.text: Write path: PostToolUse hook fires, SHA-256 dedup in a 5-minute window, privacy filter strips secrets and API keys, stores raw observation, then synthetic or LLM-written compression, then vector embedding when a provider is active, then indexes in BM25 plus vectors

A known bug where Buffer pool slicing caused phantom '2048 dimensions on disk' reads was fixed by passing byteOffset and byteLength explicitly in the base64 encode/decode round-trip. Tracked in issues #455, #469, #584, #587.
The shutdown save is issued but the iii engine requires ~2 s to flush its file-based KV to .bin; under docker stop the engine is killed before the flush completes, silently losing the index update.
The engine loads the bin file into an in-memory copy at boot; the file store and the live in-memory state are separate — fixing the file alone does not restore reads until restart
Vectors (embeddings) are stored in an in-memory Map keyed by obsId, each entry also carrying a sessionId, providing per-observation and per-session isolation at the vector level.
Store distinguishes curated memory writes from raw session observations: memory_save persists explicit facts/decisions; observations are a separate log searched by memory_recall
The store holds multiple distinct memory object types: sessions, observation scopes, lessons, summaries, semantic memories, crystals, insights, and a graph of nodes and edges
Memory slots are editable, size-limited, pinnable units injected into context across sessions; pinned slots are included in context injection by default
Memory provenance tracing: memory_verify traces a memory's citation chain back to source observations and session context, returning confidence scores
Saving a near-duplicate memory supersedes the existing one into a version chain; recall returns only current versions while history remains queryable.
Memory isolation is per-project: a scoped consolidation run only evolves memories belonging to the same project, preventing cross-project corruption.
No existing supported lifecycle operation can detach a single provenance reference from a single node or edge without destructive side effects.
Retrieval is cosine-similarity search over all stored vectors, returning the top-N results by score with their obsId, sessionId, and score.
The memory_smart_search MCP tool is a named interface to the smart-search endpoint, and silently swallows errors by returning empty results
agentmemory maintains a persistent store of observations; a local instance can accumulate hundreds of thousands of entries across sessions
Memory decay and auto-eviction modeled on Ebbinghaus curve; frequently accessed memories strengthen; contradictions detected and resolved
No supported prune path exists; collection reset is the only workaround — store treats a missing collection file as healthy-and-empty
Write path: memory_save triggers mem::remember with content, type (default 'fact'), concepts, files, project, and optional agentId.
Sketch (temporary memory) can be promoted to a permanent memory via mem::sketch-promote, implying a two-stage write path.
Lessons support soft-delete: deleted lessons are excluded from recall; re-saving the same content creates a fresh lesson
Related issue #1171 confirms absence of a per-node update endpoint and notes unbounded provenance growth as a known gap.
Forget (hard delete) with audit trail: memory_governance_delete removes specific memories by ID and records a reason
A dedicated smart-search endpoint performs hybrid/vector search distinct from the keyword/BM25 search path
Superseded memory versions are excluded from recall paths; version chain in KV keeps full history
Persistent state is stored on disk in a platform data directory and survives stop/restart
Default stream weights are BM25=0.4, vector=0.6, graph=0.3, applied during RRF fusion.
Automatic context injection into agent turns is opt-in via AGENTMEMORY_INJECT_CONTEXT
4-tier memory consolidation pipeline: working -> episodic -> semantic -> procedural
Memory is scoped per session; sessions can be forgotten (deleted) and re-imported
Auto-forgetting via TTL expiry, contradiction detection, and importance eviction
Individual observations can be removed (deleted) from the vector index by obsId.
Slot scope is per-project or global (shared across projects)

ledger.claim: Memory pipeline: raw observation stored first, then synthetic or LLM-written compression, then vector embedding, then BM25/vector indexing — distinguishing log (raw observation) from curated memory write
ledger.quote:
PostToolUse hook fires
-> SHA-256 dedup (5min window)
-> Privacy filter (strip secrets, API keys)
-> Store raw observation
-> Synthetic compression by default
(LLM-written compression only with a provider + AGENTMEMORY_AUTO_COMPRESS=true)
-> Vector embedding when an embedding provider is active
-> Index in BM25, plus vectors when enabled
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Memory isolation is per-project: the scoped consolidation path enforces that a memory can only be evolved by a run sharing the same project value, preventing cross-project title collisions from corrupting each other's memory chains.

ledger.claim: Shutdown index save is lost to a container teardown race: save() completes but the iii engine is killed ~2 s before its flush to .bin lands, causing all memories indexed since last restart to become permanently unsearchable while KV data and exit codes appear intact.
ledger.quote: The shutdown save is issued and acknowledged, then lost in transit. `save()` completes and `process.exit(0)` is reached ~0.3 s later, while the `iii` engine needs ~2 s to flush its file-based KV to `.bin`. Under `docker stop`, the engine is a child of PID 1 and is SIGKILLed along with the container before the flush lands.
ledger.label: inferred
